zh.title: 國防部偵獲共機1架次及共艦7艘 共機進入臺灣西南防空識別區
zh.summary: 截至11月19日上午6時，國防部偵獲1架次共機、7艘共艦及2艘公務船。共機架次較前一日的9架次減少。
body: 國防部表示，從11月18日上午6時至19日上午6時，在臺灣周邊偵獲1架次中共軍機、7艘中共軍艦及2艘公務船。這架次軍機越過臺灣海峽中線，進入臺灣西南防空識別區。
與國防部前一天公布的同一時段統計相比，共機由9架次降至1架次，共艦由6艘增至7艘，公務船維持2艘。

en.title: Taiwan reports one PLA aircraft sortie into its southwestern ADIZ
en.summary: Taiwan’s defense ministry reported one PLA aircraft sortie, seven PLA Navy ships and two official ships in the 24 hours to 6 a.m. on November 19.
body: Taiwan’s Ministry of National Defense reported one PLA aircraft sortie, seven PLA Navy ships and two official ships around Taiwan between 6 a.m. on November 18 and 6 a.m. on November 19, local time. The aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and entered Taiwan’s southwestern air defense identification zone.
The ministry’s previous daily report recorded nine aircraft sorties and six PLA Navy ships. The number of official ships remained at two.

facts.claim: The November 19 report lists one PLA aircraft sortie, seven PLA Navy ships and two official ships.
The aircraft crossed the Taiwan Strait median line and entered Taiwan’s southwestern ADIZ.
The November 18 report lists nine PLA aircraft sorties, six PLA Navy ships and two official ships.
